title: Jeevana Chaitra
desc: A man discovers that alcohol is a major problem in the villages, where men buy alcohol with the minimal money they have and do not work, while the wives and children get neglected and abused.

title: Grama Devathe
desc: Angala Parameswari, an avatar of Goddess Parvati, wants to protect the people of Earth. Kaveri, her ardent follower, seeks her help when her life is in danger.

title: Thavarina Theru
desc: Sridhar, an orphaned villager with a quiet heart, finds love in Shruti, but their path forward is tangled in her deep sense of duty towards her struggling family.

title: Maryade Ramanna
desc: With the hope of beginning anew, a man returns to his village to sell a piece of his land. On the way, he falls in love with a young woman, only to find out later that her parents want him dead.

title: Neelambari
desc: Vinod and his TV channel crew arrive in a village for a crucial assignment. A series of spooky events is set in motion after they interview a mysterious woman who lives there.
